desc:
👋 Welcome to Stairs To KPop Demon Hunters!
Climb thousands of stairs to meet your favorite characters like Jinu, Zoey, Rumi, and more!

🎤 Play as iconic characters from KPop Demon Hunters!
👫 Climb with friends and race to the top together!
🎁 Reach the end to unlock awesome rewards and surprises!
⚔️ Use fun gears and abilities to make your climb easier (or harder for others 👀)

🔥 Can you make it to the top and face the demons?

👍 Support the game with a Like & Favorite!
